purpose.summary: This is a batch reporting program (ORCBG016) that is part of the ORCA Japanese Medical Association standard receipt (claims) software. It queries and aggregates medical treatment act (診療行為) counts for a specified period, producing a report of designated medical procedure occurrence counts. It reads indexed files for treatment act usage and accounting data, processes parameters such as year-month, inpatient/outpatient classification, department code, and procedure codes, and outputs results.
